exposure: positional care combined with doula delivery during childbirth
cohort: 108 pregnant women with abnormal fetal orientation, recruited from February 2018 to February 2021 at Jinan City People's Hospital.
finding: Positional care combined with doula delivery effectively corrected abnormal fetal orientation, improved eutocia rates, reduced maternal pain and fear, shortened delivery duration, and enhanced neonatal outcomes and patient satisfaction compared to routine nursing.
mod_finding: The intervention group, receiving positional care combined with doula delivery, achieved a higher eutocia rate.
